description: Read-side catalog record describing a single administrative procedure (申請 / Antrag / petition / filing) operated by a government agency. Authored by L4 ingest scripts (`70-tools/scripts/gov/`); consumed by L3 appview routing and by membrane policies that decide whether a religious-corp procedure can substitute. Per ADR-2605242330 §3.4 this is the schema target for the L4 ingest wave. The `routingAround` field optionally points to a religious-corp Pregel cell (`40-engine/kotoba/crates/kotoba-kotodama/cells/*`) that offers a parallel substrate for the same outcome under ADR-2605192100 §1.12.

agencyDid.description: DID of the operating agency. Resolves to `com.etzhayyim.gov.agency`.

procedureCode.description: Agency-internal procedure ID / form number / stylesheet code. Format: agency-defined. Example for JP: `e-Gov:1234567890` (e-Gov procedure registration ID), `mhlw:R5-form-12-1`. For US: `regulations.gov:DOC-2024-0042`. For EU: `EUR-Lex:32024R0123`.

titleLocal.description: Local-script title. Example: '婚姻届の提出'.

category.description: High-level procedure category. Aligns with the COFOG-aligned 8 path-based DID set under `orgs/etzhayyim/com-etzhayyim-app-gov/appview/` (healthcare / insurance / welfare / education / prevention / housing / employment / child-family) plus additional categories for procedures outside the public-services hub.

feeJpy.description: Fee in JPY-equivalent base units. Use `0` for free procedures. Currency-conversion is record-author's responsibility; original-currency fee belongs in `feeNote`.

feeNote.description: Free-form fee note (original currency, fee schedule reference, fee waivers).

onlineUri.description: Canonical online submission URI, if `online` is in `channel`.

processingDays.description: Posted/typical processing time in calendar days. `0` = same day. Use the published upper bound where the agency cites a range.

legalBasis.description: Citation of the statute / regulation that grounds this procedure. Format: `<jurisdiction>:<corpus>:<id>:<article>`. Example: `jpn:law:民法:第739条`.

languages.description: ISO 639-1 / 639-3 language codes the procedure is published in.

routingAround.description: Optional reference to a religious-corp Pregel cell (`40-engine/kotoba/crates/kotoba-kotodama/cells/<cell-name>`) that offers a parallel substrate for the same outcome (per ADR-2605192100 §1.12 routing-around). Format: `kotodama:cells:<cell-name>`. Note that the routing-around cell is *not* a replacement service — it operates within the religious boundary only, for adherents only.

sourceUri.description: Authoritative source URL (procedure registry entry, regulation text, form-instruction PDF).

ingestRun.description: Optional reference to the L4 ingest run that produced this record. Format: `<script-name>:<git-sha>:<run-iso>`. Lets repeated ingests dedupe by source.
